newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Canada's Argentina Gold starting drilling.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Argentina Gold starting drilling.

text.p: Canada's Argentina Gold is beginning its third exploration season at its Veladero prospect in Argentina's San Juan province where it will spend $2 million this summer season, a top official said Friday.
"We will drill about 10,000 meters at Veladero this season," Argentina Gold administration manager Guillermo Jones told Reuters.

He said that last year's campaign at the site, which is at high altitude where work is impossible in winter, had discovered gold in a pipe formation but that more had to be found to make a development feasible at the site.

Argentina Gold, part of the Lundin group, has a 60 percent share in Veladero in joint-venture with fellow Canadians Barrick Gold Corp. The exploration contact signed with San Juan province for the site will allow for two further seasons' work after 1996/97.
Argentina Gold also has other Argentine exploration joint-ventures with Barrick and with Australia's WMC Ltd .
